user.title: Frigate camera as virtual radar
user.description: Turns the Frigate person boxes of one camera into X/Y targets for Radar Map Manager. Paste the calibration from the calibration tool; you can also leave it empty and add it later under Configure.

data_description.radar_name: Lowercase letters, digits and _. Gives sensor.<name>_target_1_x; in RMM you add the radar with this name.
data_description.stale_timeout: Safety net only: Frigate normally reports when an object is gone.
data_description.calibration: Four or more floor points: pixel in the camera image and position on the floor plan.

error.invalid_name: Use lowercase letters, digits and _ only, starting with a letter.
error.invalid_calibration: The calibration could not be read or its points do not lie on one floor plane. Copy it again from the calibration tool.

abort.already_configured: A virtual radar with this name already exists.
